title: Projective resolutions have augmentation preserving homotopy equivalences
statement:
Let $R$ be an associative unital ring, not necessarily commutative, and let $T$ be a left $R$-module. Let $P_\bullet\xrightarrow{\epsilon_P}T$ and $Q_\bullet\xrightarrow{\epsilon_Q}T$ be exact augmented nonnegative chain complexes of left $R$-modules [def-weil-pbc-module-chain-complex-homology] (augmented exactness means that $\epsilon_P$ is surjective, $\ker\epsilon_P=\operatorname{im}d^P_1$, and $\ker d^P_n=\operatorname{im}d^P_{n+1}$ for $n\geq1$, and likewise for $Q$) whose terms are projective, meaning that every map from a term lifts through every surjective $R$-linear map. There exist $R$-linear chain maps $u:P_\bullet\to Q_\bullet$ and $v:Q_\bullet\to P_\bullet$ such that $\epsilon_Q u_0=\epsilon_P$, $\epsilon_P v_0=\epsilon_Q$, and $vu$ and $uv$ are chain homotopic to the respective identity maps. Explicitly, there exist $R$-linear maps $h_n:P_n\to P_{n+1}$ and $k_n:Q_n\to Q_{n+1}$ ($n\geq0$) with
$$(vu-1)_n=d^P_{n+1}h_n+h_{n-1}d^P_n,\qquad(uv-1)_n=d^Q_{n+1}k_n+k_{n-1}d^Q_n,$$
where $h_{-1}=k_{-1}=0$.

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line: take C = ModuleCat R, X = T, P and Q the given augmented projective resolutions, in homotopyEquiv (180–187), homotopyEquiv_hom_π (190–191) and homotopyEquiv_inv_π (194–195). ModuleCat R is abelian for Ring R, with no commutativity requirement; projectivity is the lifting property by IsProjective.iff_projective, Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/Projective.lean:41–44. The structure ProjectiveResolution in CategoryTheory/Preadditive/Projective/Resolution.lean:41–52 is exactly a nonnegative degreewise-projective complex with quasi-isomorphic augmentation to T[0], equivalent here to the stated augmented exactness. Its HomotopyEquiv fields give the two displayed homotopy equations, and the two cited π lemmas give the two augmentation equations.
